summary: NewGenIvf Group Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing a Repurchase and Forbearance Agreement with JAK Opportunities VI LLC on June 15, 2026. The Company will repurchase outstanding convertible notes and warrants originally issued in 2024 and 2025 under two Securities Purchase Agreements, with an aggregate principal amount noted on the signature page. Forbearance payments are to be made in scheduled installments. The repurchase reduces outstanding convertible debt and warrant overhang. The exact price per share or total repurchase value is not disclosed. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The agreement involves a private investor and extinguishes existing convertible instruments. Watch for the impact on diluted share count and any potential future financing needs.
